lines: Caveman browse uses only 121 tokens instead of Playwright's 15704.
AI tools read huge files like CSVs that waste tokens on details you do not need.
Caveman is a skill for coding agents that lets them read logs and data without wasting tokens.
Caveman acts as a proxy that shrinks input tokens by 33.2 percent while keeping all answers right.
Adobe Research found cost cut 1.4 to 2.4 times per mode.
Caveman compresses memory files to 46% size while keeping every heading and code block intact.
Install it with npx skills add JuliusBrussee/caveman -g to get started now.
Julius Brussee made this with Apache-2.0 licence and has 110,358 GitHub stars; its source uses mostly Go.
Run this command in your terminal to install the skill.
Save this for a coder tired of huge AI token bills.
Caveman makes AI talk less and work right.
